description.value: Stanley Park Brewing is a craft brewery and brewpub restaurant situated at the edge of Stanley Park, one of Vancouver's most iconic cycling corridors. The brewery crafts beers with names drawn from the park itself — Trail Hopper IPA, Windstorm West Coast Pale Ale, Natural Habitat Lager — giving touring cyclists a thematic stop after riding the seawall or park trails. Both reservations and walk-ins are welcome, and their canned beers are available for online delivery.
